book.name: MAKI
book.title: Jisesi Kalaestida gala lalo Makimamo luhuwa jibo

content: Jisesi maya helenebokuti sinaiye.

Onawa makokoma minikiki holi onawa maya alo suwokaiye likiki Magadala numutoti mena Mele ito Mele mako Jemisida dola ito mena Salomelekiya Jisesida ono upalaloma nuwalaki netupama hiletatune liki meina hitae.
Sakiya meina hiki likiki nekewa napa yeikamaya Sadeu maya ono molabotoka maya wiwa wiwa niayoko, ho maya yowiye.
Sakiya ono molaboto alili wikadanaki edimonipolokaya wetome-katome iki ehada napa maya ale epaloti maya ekahimamo ipisoko le huloletatiye liki lae.
Liki likiki mudabo maya, aya ehada maya alo ipisiki li ilikaloka molikayoko, ale epawa maya golotoneyoko mudai-minae.
Sa-okaiyoko, aya aleu maya yowiki mudabo maya okanaki we owahakidana makoya ukulo lawo-lawo hana olo jekoko lamawaka sinoneyoko, mudaikiki aya menakipa maya ololo ae.

Sakiya ololo niayoko, aya wemamoya ololo amilo loko lo biye. Edimoya Naseleti we Jisesida yoho yaha yalo kohaiki tebo we maya muda-elakili nisehe. Aya we maya mauya minamiye. Alo sinokaiyo, onowa molaboku maya mudalo.
Mudaikiki wiki unala ipapala yuha malokasida maya ito Pitalesidamakiya omutoko lo libibo nesa leko le omutokoya Galeli mikauka maya wetibo nenako, yaloka maya wiki muda-elakilae, liki li bilo.

Loko liyoko, luwo-luwo nijedanaki ololo abo nenako, ayauti maya hetoka maya limikiki oli wae. Sakiya domoda adoha wokaiyoko nenako, oli niwiki we makomidana wetome iki li mamae. 7 Mat 26:32; Mak 14:28 Jisesimamoya Magadala numutoti mena Meleda omudalo soto piye. (Jon 20:11-18) [
Jisesi maya Sadeu nekewa napa aleuti lubukaya sinokadanaki Magadala numutoti mena Mele oloha lahelamibo 7-palasidaya ukauti kohaidoko doli hibo menamidana omudaloya ada soto piye.
Sa-okaiyoko aya menamamoya woko wewenalale maya miluma-aluma eliki wije nama nileyoko wetome oko lo biye.
Helenebokuti maya sinokoko aha neyoko mudaoe loko libo maya aya wewenasiya elewole iki data kamae.
Jisesimamoya unala ipalale lowesito soto pibo.
Sa-okaiyoko, we loweya ohuguka maya niwaiyoko Jisesi maya omutoko nebokidana amoko aito aweyaha oko domudalo soto piye.
Sa-okaiyoko, edimosiya wiki maloka wewenasida maya wetome iki li beiboya, aya wewenasiya elewole iki data kamae.
Jisesimamoya aposolosida maya monoka yowanulo doli hiye.

Alikaya Jisesi maya unala ipalale yuha 11-pala maya edimonipogo li esa iki miniki nodenesa ninayoko, soto pe bekadanaki aleuti maya sinokoko niseko neyoko emoda ada muda-elabo wewenasida ganipo maya wati ga lae liki lamabo ito data elewole iki elamabo maya nenako, yamuya auha biye.
Sakokoya edimoya numuto namatoya wiki ho noyowibotoka ho nolimibotoka moniki muki wewenasidaya nemo ane lalo maya wetome iki li bilo.
Sa-ideko edimo gatipo eli elewole ikiki monoka noku udatabo wewenasida maya olisauti dilimekoyoko minatabo ne, ito gatipolo eli elewole amitabo wewena maya jomidana epa nesala lolo ikilae.
Ito maya ganeya elewole iki elitabo wewenalokaya sako soto pebetakolaiye: Nemo nulinelotiya oloha lahelamabosida maya kohaidiki doli hitae. Ito aito aito dono jiki ga liki likilae.
Ito oletehaya opa li sawa jiki minatabo ito nalisa no nataboya, yatoka nesalimoya dilipe opa napa amekolaiye. Ito saina delatibo wewenasida maya dadeloti sisiwanipo jitaboya, haka likilae. 15 Apo 1:8
Jisesi maya okulumau yowiye.
Sa-loko we napa Jisesimamoya lo bekaiyoko, Omailimoya ilime-loko okulumau yoweko ade lamawakaloka hulotoneyoko ne.
Sa-iyoko, unala ipalale yuhamasiya muki numuto namato maya wikadanaki gala maya li nibeyoko, We napamamo dilipe wati idanaki oliwaki elewole nesa le soto pibodunuya ganipo maya le elewole obetaiye.]
